messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:42:00 +0000
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO path for freelance contractors (EMEA pilot)

Team —

Acme Talent (contractor staffing partner) has asked for a streamlined onboarding route for local freelancers in the EMEA region. Their ask: allow invoice-only (no PO) processing for short-term contractors while we run a 12-week pilot. Rationale: many EMEA local contractors operate under payroll/umbrella arrangements and adding a PO for each engagement is causing weeks of delay.

I attached a draft SOW and our proposed onboarding form. High-level guardrails I suggest:
- Max spend per contractor: EUR 5,000 / month
- Pre-approved SOW signed and retained by Legal
- Weekly invoice reporting to AP with a specific AP tag (will be created by Marissa)
- Procurement to maintain a central register (Jonas/ Priya) and cap count at 25 active contractors for pilot

Please review and confirm whether Procurement + Finance can provisionally approve a no-PO flow for 12 weeks, and whether Legal (Mina) is comfortable with the SOW language. If we agree, next steps would be: finalize SOW/Onboarding form, set AP tag, and update the Confluence playbook.

Goal: reduce onboarding time from 10+ business days to 48 hours for frontline teams while we validate controls.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: SOW_ACMETALENT_v2.docx; freelancer_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO path for freelance contractors (EMEA pilot)

Laura — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. A few quick questions before Procurement commits:
1) Is Acme Talent acting as an employer-of-record (EoR) or as an agency billing on behalf of freelancers? That changes tax/withholding liability.
2) Expected monthly run-rate across all contractors in pilot (ballpark). The EUR 5k cap per contractor is reasonable, but we need total exposure.
3) Will each contractor have a separate SOW or one master agreement with individual statements?

Procurement's provisional suggestion: we can accept a temporary no-PO route if Finance agrees to an AP tag + automated spend alerts, and Legal signs off on the SOW. Mina — can you scan SOW_v2 for any clauses we must add (indemnity, IP assignment, data handling for PII)? Marcus/Marissa — can Finance draft a short memo so AP knows to route these invoices to the special tag?

I'll hold on final sign-off until we have answers to the above.

- Priya

From: Sarah Park <sarah@acmetalent.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 07:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO path for freelance contractors (EMEA pilot)

Hi Laura & team,

Thanks for sending — we typically operate as an agency that invoices on behalf of freelancers (we're not EoR in all markets). We can provide per-contractor SOWs or a master agreement with appended statements — either works for us as long as the invoice lines map cleanly to the SOW.

Attached is a sample invoice workflow and our preferred DocuSign link for SOW execution. We can limit active contractors to 25 and provide weekly batch invoices. We already have EU tax paperwork on file for the pool.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/AcmeTalent-SOW-v2

Let me know if you prefer a quick call to align on operational details. Happy to support a pilot cadence.

Best,
Sarah Park
Head of Partnerships, Acme Talent
Attachment: sample_invoice_flow.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO path for freelance contractors (EMEA pilot)

Thanks — copied the key points below and my recommendation.

> Acme acts as agency invoicing on behalf of freelancers
> Pilot: 12 weeks, cap 25 active contractors
> Guardrails: EUR 5k/month per contractor, signed SOWs, AP tag, weekly reporting

Finance position (provisional): Acceptable for a timeboxed pilot with the following additional controls:
- AP to create a unique "NoPO-EMEA" tag and receive an automated feed of weekly invoices (Marissa to set up)
- Each invoice must reference the SOW ID and a short PO-equivalent reference (e.g., NOPO-[vendor]-[YYYYMM])
- Spend alert: send procurement + finance an email when cumulative vendor spend > EUR 25k in the pilot month
- Retain supporting SOWs and proof of work for 7 years (audit requirement)

I'll draft a short one-page memo (finance_template_no-po-memo.xlsx attached) that Procurement can keep with the vendor record. Legal (Mina) — if any IP/data clauses are needed, call them out and we'll fold into the SOW.

On the operational side, this preserves AP controls while removing the PO bottleneck. Priya/Jonas — if you confirm the register/process, Finance can enable the tag within 48 hours.

- Marcus
